privacyBody: Continuity Binder has no user account and no binder-data backend.
Binder entries are processed locally and encrypted records are stored in browser storage on this device.
Your passphrase is not stored. The application uses no analytics, advertising, or session replay.
The static host necessarily receives ordinary request metadata when serving site assets.
Exports leave the application only when you choose to save or print them. Clearing site data or the browser profile can delete local binder data. Create encrypted backups.
securityBody: The vault encrypts binder records with AES-GCM. Your passphrase derives a key that wraps the vault encryption key.
The binder can auto-lock after inactivity and works locally after its assets are available.
This protects local records against casual access, but cannot protect an unlocked device, a compromised browser, or copies you print or export.
termsBody: Continuity Binder is an organizational tool. It does not provide legal, tax, financial, medical, insurance, or estate-planning advice and does not create or replace a will, trust, power of attorney, beneficiary designation, directive, or other legal instrument.
Verify legal documents and beneficiary designations with the appropriate institutions or professionals.
